label.title: Funding (same-slope lean; formula TBD, update-2). PLACEHOLDER: the same-slope pool-vs-anchor deviation carrying the ±g sign/scale — NOT the final funding number. Signed: + = line received, − = line paid. Line P/L shown includes this placeholder accrual; cash at close settles ex-funding until the transfer layer ships.
label.noteText: Every row above a TOTAL carries CARVED-PERP units (stage 2). The single dollar figure is the TOTAL row's settlement cell — the one stage-2 → stage-3 equity multiply. Effective strike = original strike (OTM) or perp mark (ITM); regime is perp-mark-decided. Funding column is a PLACEHOLDER — the same-slope pool-vs-anchor LEAN (deviation) carrying the ±g sign/scale, NOT the final funding number; the funding formula is TBD (update-2). Signed P/L effect (+ received, − paid; ledger stores trader-pays, display negates). Line P/L shown INCLUDES this placeholder accrual; cash at close settles EX-funding until the funding transfer layer ships.
